events_detected.title: US-Japan Joint Yen Intervention — US Sold Euros to Buy Yen
events_detected.description: US Treasury and Japan MOF conducted rare coordinated currency intervention to prop up the yen. The US reportedly sold euros (not dollars) to buy yen, blindsiding the ECB. Estimated Japanese intervention ~$75bn, US operation $5-10bn. Yen at 4-decade highs before intervention. Bessent's notepad: 'To Do Buy Japanese Yen $5-10 bil'. Intervention failing to deliver lasting boost — yen wobbling near 160 as of Aug 11.

events_detected.title: 2026 Ebola Epidemic — Fastest Growing Outbreak on Record, WHO PHEIC Declared

Declared public health emergency of international concern (PHEIC).
